evals.prompt: Create a Dockerfile for a Node.js API server that connects to MariaDB. It should run on port 3000 and needs the mysql2 npm package. Include Claude Code as the AI agent.
evals.expected_output: A multi-stage hardened Dockerfile with DHI node base image, digest pin, non-root user, healthcheck, OCI labels, Claude Code agent installed via build stage, and a compose snippet with seccomp/AppArmor for agent role
expectations: All FROM lines use dhi.io/ base images
All FROM lines include @sha256: digest pin or REPLACE_WITH_ACTUAL_DIGEST placeholder
Uses multi-stage build with separate build and runtime stages
Runtime stage uses --no-install-recommends on apt-get install
Cache cleanup (rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*) in same RUN layer as apt-get install
Non-root USER with UID 1000 is defined
HEALTHCHECK instruction is present and targets port 3000
OCI labels (org.opencontainers.image.*) are present
Claude Code (@anthropic-ai/claude-code) is installed in build stage via npm install -g
Agent binaries are copied from build stage using COPY --from=build
npm is not left in the runtime stage (or justified if present)
PATH includes /usr/local/ai-cli-bin for CarapaBox compatibility
jq is installed in the runtime image for run-agent.sh compatibility
CVE scan hook is provided as a before-start.sh snippet (runs on host, not inside container)
Compose snippet includes seccomp:seccomp-default.json and apparmor=carapabox-agent
Compose snippet includes read_only: true and cap_drop: ALL
Compose snippet includes tmpfs mounts for /tmp and /run
Compose snippet includes deploy.resources.limits with pids for every service
Compose snippet includes logging driver with max-size and max-file limits
No secrets (API keys, passwords) appear in ARG, ENV, or COPY instructions

evals.prompt:
Harden this existing Dockerfile:

FROM debian:bookworm-slim
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y bash curl git nodejs npm python3 ripgrep && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY bridge.js /usr/local/bin/model-bridge
RUN chmod +x /usr/local/bin/model-bridge
RUN groupadd -g 1000 sandbox && useradd -m -u 1000 -g sandbox -s /bin/bash sandbox
USER sandbox
WORKDIR /workspace
CMD ["sleep", "infinity"]
evals.expected_output: A hardened replacement Dockerfile using DHI base images, digest pins, multi-stage build, minimal packages with comments, and security defaults
expectations: Replaces debian:bookworm-slim with a dhi.io/ base image
All FROM lines include @sha256: digest pin or placeholder
Uses multi-stage build (at least build + runtime stages)
Uses --no-install-recommends on apt-get install
npm package is removed from runtime (Node.js DHI image provides node without npm)
Every installed package has a comment explaining why it is needed
Cache cleanup in same layer as install
bridge.js is copied via COPY --from=build pattern
Non-root USER sandbox with UID 1000 is preserved
HEALTHCHECK instruction is added
OCI labels are added
CVE scan hook is provided as a before-start.sh snippet (runs on host, not inside container)
Compose snippet is provided with security_opt settings
Compose snippet includes deploy.resources.limits with pids for every service
Compose snippet includes logging driver with max-size and max-file limits

evals.prompt: Create a Dockerfile for a static nginx site that serves a React build from the ./build directory. No AI agents needed — this is a pure runtime service.
evals.expected_output: A multi-stage Dockerfile using DHI nginx base, copying only static assets, with no build tools or agents in the final image
expectations: Uses dhi.io/nginx:stable-debian13 as the runtime base image
All FROM lines include @sha256: digest pin or placeholder
Uses multi-stage build — build stage compiles React, runtime serves static files
Runtime stage contains only nginx and static assets (no node, npm, or build tools)
COPY --from=build copies only the built static files to nginx html directory
Non-root user is configured or nginx runs as non-root
HEALTHCHECK instruction is present
OCI labels are present
No AI agents are installed (pure runtime service)
CVE scan hook is provided as a before-start.sh snippet (runs on host, not inside container)
Compose snippet uses seccomp-web.json and apparmor=carapabox-web (not agent profile)
Compose snippet includes read_only: true with tmpfs for /var/cache/nginx and /run
Compose snippet includes deploy.resources.limits with pids for every service
Compose snippet includes logging driver with max-size and max-file limits
No secrets in the image layers
